KaTeX 0.19.0, distributed under the bundled MIT license.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

The renderer, CSS and WOFF2 fonts are vendored so LaTeX rendering needs no CDN.
The website uses the WOFF2 sources; legacy WOFF/TTF fallbacks in upstream CSS are not bundled.
This is separate from `tools/katex`, which validates the model’s documentation.
